title: JSFL runtime tests: missing coverage for moveSelectionBy, duplicateSelection, duplicateItem, copyFrames, setFillColor, findSymbolInstances
description:
Add missing test coverage to packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/__tests__/runtime-expanded.test.ts for JSFL methods that are implemented but untested:

1. doc.moveSelectionBy(delta) — test that selected object x/y changes by the delta
2. doc.duplicateSelection() — test that a new object is created offset from the original
3. library.duplicateItem(name) — test that a 'Copy of X' item appears in library
4. timeline.copyFrames() / pasteFrames() — test that frame contents can be copied and pasted
5. doc.setFillColor('#ff0000') / doc.setStrokeColor('#0000ff') — test state is stored and affects addNewRectangle fill
6. doc.findSymbolInstances(symbolName) — test that placed instances of a named symbol are returned

Pattern: Each test should create a minimal fixture document with a symbol/shape, run the JSFL method, then assert the expected state change. Look at existing tests in runtime-expanded.test.ts (e.g., the convertToSymbol tests around line 602) as the template for structure.
